BiblicalUsage: Ibzan was a judge of Israel from Bethlehem, and the Bible gives him two verses. In Judges 12:8 he judged Israel seven years, and in Judges 12:10 he died and was buried at Bethlehem, after thirty sons and thirty daughters married out of his house.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ibzan's short record is a quiet one: seven years of judging, a great family, and a burial at home. Not every faithful life gets a long story.
